{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The game shall be played with three players."},
{"id": 2, "text": "The program shall decide the players' turn order randomly at the beginning of the game."},
{"id": 3, "text": "A player shall earn a special point every time he takes all the cards from the table during his turn."},
{"id": 4, "text": "The game shall be played with a deck of 40 cards, divided into four suits: Coins, Cups, Swords, and Clubs."},
{"id": 5, "text": "Each suit shall have exactly 10 cards, numbered from 1 to 12."},
{"id": 6, "text": "The game shall end when a player reaches the predetermined winning score."},
{"id": 7, "text": "The game shall allow multiple rounds until the winning score is reached."},
{"id": 8, "text": "The card deck shall be shuffled, and then each player shall receive some cards. Finally, four cards shall be placed on the table."},
{"id": 9, "text": "In each turn of the game, a player shall select a card from their hand."},
{"id": 10, "text": "If the value of the selected card matches the value of one card on the table, the player shall put it on their discard pile."},
{"id": 11, "text": "If the value of the selected card matches the value of one card on the table, the matching cards shall be put on the player's discard pile."},
{"id": 12, "text": "If the selected card does not match any card on the table, the player shall discard it."},
{"id": 13, "text": "When a player has no cards left on their hand, they shall receive three new cards from the deck."},
{"id": 14, "text": "The round shall end when all the cards have been distributed to the players. If there are any cards left on the table, the player who last drew cards shall take them on their discard pile."},
{"id": 15, "text": "After the round has ended, all players shall tally up their points. If any player reaches the predetermined score, the game shall end."},
{"id": 16, "text": "At the end of each round, each player shall receive points for the following: the most cards, the most Coins cards, the seven of Coins, and the highest sum of their cards."}
]}
